verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of C2PA metadata, content credentials, or a disclosed provenance watermark on generated videos. The only watermark mention is the free tier's '3 videos a month, watermarked'. That is a plan-limitation branding mark, an adjacent feature rather than a documented provenance signal. A community comment noting viewers had no easy way to verify a HeyGen-dubbed video further suggests no provenance signal was visible.
